title: Amazing Grace Harbor Tours

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The Amazing Grace is the perfect vessel for company outings, school groups, wedding parties, private tours, shuttle service, photoshoots, and other events. Cruise by the Newport Bridge, Rose Island, Fort Adams, and The Mansions experiencing spectacular panoramas of the bay and the fresh sea breezes. M/V AMAZING GRACE ONE-HOUR NARRATED TOURThe Amazing Grace is 55 feet in length, holds up to 75 people, and features two full decks, indoor and outdoor seating with refreshments, 2 restrooms on board, and a full-service bar. Functions: Tour and school groups, company outings, wedding parties, private charters, and memorial services. PRIVATE CHARTERSWeekdays: $875 per hour plus 15%
